exact_statement: For every uniform-cube Boolean sign and finite deterministic fresh-singleton stopping tree, on its actual coherent root lift let S be the root Fourier-square sample, Q the final queried set, W=S\Q, D=S intersect Q, and A any fixed superset of all possibly queried coordinates. With a=I_A(f) and R=I(f)-E I(f_leaf), the injected information is e=I(W;Pi|S)=H(D|S), E|D|=R, a-R=E I_A(f_leaf), and e<=a h2(R/a). The bound is the cross-entropy of ONE normalized conditional reference rho_theta(d|S)=theta^|d|(1-theta)^(|S intersect A|-|d|), theta=R/a, minus its conditional KL. Root-Markov compatibility of the actual W is equivalent to e=0. Every leaf independent of A implies e=0 despite variable query sets; E I_A(f_leaf)<=kappa R implies e<=(1+kappa)h2(1/(1+kappa))R. With output information o and Gamma_W=H(Pi|Y)-H(Pi|W), one has o/2+[Gamma_W]_+/2<=R/ln(2)+e/2. The coefficient one in the active entropy capacity is asymptotically sharp on A048's actual indexed-parity point-defect family with k=2r+2. Arbitrary overlapping or identical terminal data cores are permitted when all controller dependence is resolved. Terminal Fourier entropy and influence remain retained; no universal history-bank supply or FEI conclusion is proved.

A fixed superset of all potentially queried coordinates; actual physical influence

exact_statement: Let an exclusive controller with probabilities q_j select Boolean cores u_j on a possibly shared data cube, and let R_lab=sum_j q_j log2(1/q_j) Var(u_j). Multiplying the whole output by an independent unqueried Boolean v of mean b changes R_lab by (1-b^2)sum_j q_j log2(1/q_j)(E u_j)^2, while leaving every controller-query physical influence and erased/channel Fourier ledger unchanged. For all integers m,n>=1, G=1-2(1-AND_m(z))AND_n(x) and F=yG with a fresh fair sign y have all-essential short-circuit controller trees, t=2^-m, delta=2^-n, I_ctrl=2mt delta, R_lab(G)=4delta(1-delta)psi(1-t), R_lab(F)=h2(t), and zero terminal labelled reserve. Thus the total labelled control release/I_ctrl>=2^(n-1), uniformly in m. H(F)=H(G), expected terminal Fourier entropy=(1-t)H(h_n), terminal influence(F)=1+(1-t)2n delta. The summed residual D-kappa shifts by exactly minus the reserve boost, so R_lab(root)+sum reach(D-kappa)=H(root)-E H_leaf is common-factor invariant. Independent complete tensor copies add all these quantities without an additional logarithm. This refutes only the unsupported shared-data extension of a dimension-independent independent-core reserve-release payment by controller influence; it refutes neither the disjoint-core source theorem, A050 active-label repair nor FEI.
